newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares surge 6 pct, sentiment strong.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares surge 6 pct, sentiment strong.

text.p: Slovenian shares jumped 5.91 percent on Monday and traders said growth could continue for months due to tenacious demand for stocks in newly privatised companies.
"Listings of newly privatised companies, which seem to appear regularly this year, offer constant incentive to the market. The index could grow by 50 percent this year," one broker said.
* The 10-share SBI index surged 87.46 points to 1,566.9.
* Overall 17 shares rose, three fell and five were untraded.
* Drug maker Lek's A issue was the most active, jumping 6.84 percent to 33,130 tolars on volume of 18,361 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
